edits.old: Infinite monitoring includes storage-layer read/write IOPS, read/write latency in milliseconds, throughput in bytes per second, throughput utilization, and logical storage usage against the effective storage limit. These measurements distinguish storage performance saturation from logical-capacity exhaustion. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
edits.new: Atlas Infinite monitoring includes storage-layer read/write IOPS, read/write latency in milliseconds, throughput in bytes per second, storage throughput utilization, and storage space used/free (bytes and percent). Separately, the cluster card Data Size chart plots logical data size against the enforced max storage limit (default 128 TB), which is distinct from the storage-layer performance metrics. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/review-available-metrics/ ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/infinite/atlas-infinite-storage/

edits.old: During public preview, Infinite storage capacity grows independently of the cluster tier, but storage IOPS and throughput are fixed by that tier. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23)
